sample: S3HT-62RW-C1Y, one page from Ledin (2026)'s final test set
selection: Selected by the author as the best-performing of 14 final test pages for the blur-trained adapter; not a representative sample
source: Figure 5.16, PDF page 64, extracted losslessly with Poppler pdfimages
source_preprocessing: Author's median-blurred image; 2037 x 1024 grayscale. Convert to RGB PNG without rescaling.
reference: Figure A.31, PDF page 92. Figure A.30 is a model prediction and is not used as truth.
reference_extraction: Poppler pdftotext -layout; select numbered rows between captions A.30 and A.31; replace TeX low double-quote glyph with two comma delimiters; preserve other characters
inference: Same RGB PNG input, BF16, greedy temperature 0, maximum 8192 output tokens; no reference labels in prompts
prompts: Both base models use chandra-ocr 0.2 OCR_PROMPT and output HTML. The published adapter uses its author's JSON prompt. This compares extraction workflows.
adapter: Primary comparison uses fine_tuned_chandra, trained on untransformed pages. The secondary run uses fine_tuned_chandra_blur, trained on median-blurred pages and used for the thesis's final evaluation. Every model receives the same blurred thesis figure. BF16 merged inference is not the author's quantized runtime.
normalization: Unicode NFC, collapsed whitespace, empty string to *, integers to strings; retain case, accents, punctuation and ditto marks
alignment: Unique printed row number. Score fields independently; duplicate or absent row IDs and unavailable fields become NaN. Retain other rows. Exact hash-bound source-audited maps are a separate assisted result.
denominator: 15 people x 6 fields = 90 cells; also report the 67 filled cells separately
format: Keep complete records, including complete JSON prefix objects if truncation occurs. Unreadable or absent fields are NaN; report syntax/termination separately. No complete structured record means 0% coverage and undefined reading accuracy.
diagnostics: Period-only, no/nó and accent-fold sensitivities operate on available cells. Exclude five flagged reference cells only in the separately labeled sensitivity.
reference_uncertainty: Retain the author's spellings even where handwriting is ambiguous; no model-assisted correction of reference labels
review_amendment: An independent visual review flagged five reference cells and missing accents. Sensitivities and the secondary blur run were added after the first inference request but before inspecting any model response.
interpretation: Agreement on one author-selected held-out page, not overall generalization performance or statistical significance
distribution: Download thesis, scan and labels on demand into ignored build/. Publish model predictions and aggregate/per-field counts only.
html_projection: Use printed-column positions, respecting explicit spans. The source-audited OCR2 holdout mapping shifts only left-page selected fields; automatic scores keep the original fixed map.
parser_amendment: The colspan rule was added after inspecting Chandra 1 output. It interprets explicit HTML cell spans; it does not infer missing columns or move field contents.
layout_diagnostic: The previously exploratory source-checked OCR2 map is now included only in explicitly assisted results. See ../../layout_audit.json for the exact mapping and hash binding. Automatic coverage and exact yield remain separately reported.
layout_amendment: After inspecting all model outputs, added emitted/aligned row counts and a separate post-hoc OCR 2 layout diagnostic. Primary scores and reference labels are unchanged.

reference_review_record.reason: Independent visual review of reference; no model response inspected

partial_scoring.normalization: NFC and collapsed whitespace; preserve case, punctuation, accents, ditto marks and all predicted characters. Paris ! and ? annotation markers become spaces; Argentina * is an extracted blank.
partial_scoring.missing: NaN means unavailable extraction/alignment, not a readable blank. Exclude NaN from conditional accuracy; count it in missing coverage. Incorrect and extracted-blank cells remain scored.
partial_scoring.character_accuracy: 1 - total Levenshtein edits / available filled reference characters, calculated within cells. Insertions, deletions and substitutions cost 1, with no clipping; accuracy can be negative. Blank reference cells have a separate exact-match measure.
partial_scoring.digit_accuracy: Same edit formula on age or birth-year cells whose normalized reference consists entirely of ASCII digits. Keep all prediction characters, including stray periods and letters. Report the available digit denominator and digit coverage.
partial_scoring.coverage: Available cells / all reference cells, with filled-cell and reference-character coverage separately. Raw automatic coverage is recorded before any hash-bound source audit.
partial_scoring.exact_yield: Exactly recovered cells / all reference cells. Unavailable cells contribute zero correct cells; this measures extraction plus reading. Report automatic and source-audited yield separately.
partial_scoring.rejected_fields: --reject-field FIELD sets that column to NaN, including otherwise readable blanks, while preserving other columns. Repeat the flag for multiple columns. Coverage and rejection metadata expose the choice.
partial_scoring.alignment_audit: layout_audit.json binds source-checked structural maps to exact raw output and reference hashes. No text similarity alignment or label copying. --automatic-only disables these maps; future outputs require their own audit.
partial_scoring.amendment: 2026-10-13: scoring revised after viewing outputs at the user request. Raw model outputs and references unchanged. Conditional scores with source assistance do not measure autonomous layout recovery.

metrics: automatic and source-audited exact recovery over all reference cells
